timing: Diagnostic contemporaneous assay: initial and current independently measured EG and current pH, known medium and elapsed time. No GA calibration. Not an online forecast or replacement of HPLC.
grouping: Complete flask conditions; three development conditions and one metadata-hash confirmation condition; leave-one-condition-out folds keep all replicates together.
primary_metric: MAE averaged within group, then equally across groups
calibration: Diagnostic contemporaneous assay: initial and current independently measured EG and current pH, known medium and elapsed time. No GA calibration. Not an online forecast or replacement of HPLC.
selection: Smallest development group-balanced OOF MAE among baseline/candidate families; within1% choose lower parameter count. Confirmation never selects reference.
continuation: At least5 material hypotheses, continue justified distinct hypotheses until2 consecutive after minimum5 show no improvement of >1% in prediction or explicit robustness/interpretation. No retuning after confirmation.
uncertainty: No row bootstrap; enumerate group errors and leave-group development variability. Single heldout condition is bounded evidence.
exposure_audit: Native CSV previews exposed several GA observations in all four flask conditions before task freezing; explicitly retrospective; no confirmation metrics used in model selection.
